title: Choose the visual world for CashFlow Control AI
question: The seed assigned 'Optical Sorting Bench'. Keep it, take the challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: High-Precision Optical Sorting Bench
options.lineage: Industrial banking scanners and optical equipment
options.body: CashFlow AI feels like an optical scanner. The screen is clinical, structured, and highly precise. Receipts slide in to be laser-scanned by the AI. The interface uses high-contrast targeting reticles (glassmorphism) to highlight mismatches between declared and OCR-read amounts. It's clean, premium, and trustworthy.

options.label: Cassette Futurist Terminal
options.body: A retro-tactile approach where the interface feels like heavy brushed aluminum equipment. Uploading a receipt is like snapping in a tape. Validation is done via heavy chrome toggles and amber LED readouts. Fun and highly distinctive.
